recommendation.title: Harden Seller Verification & Prevent Duplicate Charges
recommendation.recommendation: Institute mandatory merchant identity verification and escrow payment protection. Deploy automated checks on payment gateways to eliminate duplicate billing transactions.
recommendation.rationale: Scored 73/100 priority driven by 1423 fraud/scam incidents (81% of category total) with critical 4.4/5.0 severity.
recommendation.expected_impact: Deflect 80% of counterfeit disputes and eliminate unauthorized extra fees.

recommendation.title: Stabilize Checkout Web Service & Carrier Packaging SLAs
recommendation.recommendation: Address website checkout crashes and cart glitches under peak load. Establish strict packaging standards with carriers to prevent damaged or missing parcels.
recommendation.rationale: 1389 operational failures logged (77% negative rate), led by two-week delivery delays and checkout errors.
recommendation.expected_impact: Reduce checkout drop-offs by 65% and cut shipping damage claims.

recommendation.title: Overhaul Support Queue Routing & SLA Response Timers
recommendation.recommendation: Implement tier-1 routing with maximum 15-minute response caps for unresolved inquiries. Train agents on replacement resolution protocols.
recommendation.rationale: Customer Service accounts for 588 negative complaints out of 1707 customer touchpoints, with unresolved tickets as the dominant driver.
recommendation.expected_impact: Reduce average ticket resolution time by 45% and raise CSAT by 30 points.

recommendation.rationale: Product Feedback logged 249 defect complaints out of 1738 total reviews, with 'stopped working after a week' as primary complaint.
recommendation.expected_impact: Decrease defective unit return requests by 50% within 60 days.
